question: How many days of annual leave do full-time employees get?
ground_truth: 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, accrued at 2 days per month. Part-time employees accrue on a prorated basis.
source_anchors: Full-time employees receive 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year

question: How many leave days can I carry into next year and when do they expire?
ground_truth: Up to 5 unused days carry over, and they must be used by March 31 or they are forfeited.
source_anchors: Up to 5 unused leave days may be carried over into the following year

question: Can I use sick leave to look after my child?
ground_truth: Yes, up to 4 of your 10 annual sick days may be used to care for an immediate family member.
source_anchors: Sick leave may also be used to care for an immediate family member, up to 4 of your 10 annual sick days

question: How much parental leave is there and when do I qualify?
ground_truth: 12 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers and 4 weeks for secondary caregivers, available after 12 months of continuous employment, and it must be taken within 12 months of the birth or adoption placement.
source_anchors: Meridian provides 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for primary caregivers and 4 weeks for secondary caregivers

question: Which day of the week can I not work from home?
ground_truth: Tuesday. Tuesdays are designated in-office collaboration days for all corporate teams and cannot be taken as remote days.
source_anchors: Tuesdays are designated in-office collaboration days for all corporate teams

question: I want to work from Portugal for a month. What approval do I need?
ground_truth: Working outside the United States for more than 10 business days per year requires written approval from both HR and Legal. Remote employees must otherwise work from within the United States.
source_anchors: Working from outside the country for more than 10 business days per year requires written approval from both HR and Legal

question: What is the employee discount and is there a limit?
ground_truth: 40% on Meridian-branded products and 20% on third-party brands, up to $2,500 in total discounted purchases per calendar year.
source_anchors: Employees receive a 40% discount on all Meridian-branded products and 20% on third-party brands
notes: Deliberate distractor: compensation-benefits.md discusses the discount but defers on the numbers.

question: Does my employee discount stack with a seasonal sale?
ground_truth: No. The employee discount does not stack with promotional discounts. Checkout applies whichever is better for the employee automatically.
source_anchors: The discount does not stack with promotional discounts
The employee discount does not stack with any promotional discount

question: How does the retirement match work?
ground_truth: Meridian matches 100% of the first 3% of pay contributed and 50% of the next 2%, for a maximum match of 4% of pay. The match is applied per pay period rather than trued up annually.
source_anchors: Meridian matches 100% of the first 3% of pay contributed and 50% of the next 2%

question: If I leave after 18 months, do I keep the employer retirement match?
ground_truth: No. The employer match vests on a two-year cliff, so leaving before two years of service forfeits the match. Your own contributions vest immediately and are never forfeited.
source_anchors: The employer match vests on a two-year cliff
notes: Requires distinguishing employer match from employee contributions.

question: I work 20 hours a week. What health coverage am I eligible for?
ground_truth: Dental and vision only. Medical coverage requires being scheduled for 24 or more hours per week.
source_anchors: Part-time employees scheduled for 24 or more hours per week are eligible for medical coverage
notes: The threshold sits just above the asked figure; a careless answer says yes.

question: When do performance reviews happen and which one affects pay?
ground_truth: Twice a year, in June and December. The December cycle carries the rating that informs merit increases, which take effect January 1.
source_anchors: Formal performance reviews happen twice a year, in June and December
The December cycle carries the rating that informs merit increases

question: Is a Solid rating a warning that I am underperforming?
ground_truth: No. Solid means the employee did the job they were hired to do, well. It is the expected rating for most people in most years and is not a criticism.
source_anchors: It is the expected rating for most people in most years and is not a criticism

question: Does Meridian rank employees on a curve?
ground_truth: No. There is no forced distribution and managers are not required to place a set percentage into any rating. Calibration checks consistency of standard rather than enforcing a curve.
source_anchors: There is no forced distribution

question: How long do I have to appeal a performance rating?
ground_truth: 10 business days. The appeal is reviewed by an HR partner who was not involved in the original decision.
source_anchors: An employee may appeal a rating or a plan outcome to HR within 10 business days

question: What is the largest gift I can accept from a vendor?
ground_truth: Gifts valued above $50 may not be accepted, and cash or cash equivalents may not be accepted in any amount. Meals and event tickets in the ordinary course of business are acceptable up to $150 per occasion and must be reported above that.
source_anchors: Employees may not accept gifts from vendors valued above $50
notes: Two different thresholds; conflating them is the failure mode.

question: Do I have to report a concern to my own manager first?
ground_truth: No. Concerns may be raised with a manager, with HR, or through the anonymous ethics line. Meridian does not require reporting to your own manager first, since that would be self-defeating where the manager is the subject.
source_anchors: Meridian does not require employees to report a concern to their own manager first

question: I reported a colleague and the investigation did not substantiate it. Am I in trouble?
ground_truth: No. A report made in good faith that turns out to be mistaken is not misconduct, and retaliation against you would be grounds for termination on its own. A report the reporter knew to be false is a different matter and is itself a violation.
source_anchors: a report made in good faith that turns out to be mistaken is not misconduct
notes: Correct answer is conditional on good faith; an unqualified reassurance is incomplete.

question: Will HR tell me what punishment the person I reported received?
ground_truth: No. The reporter is informed of the outcome in general terms, but specific discipline applied to another employee is not disclosed because it is that person's private employment information.
source_anchors: Specific discipline applied to another employee is not disclosed

question: Can I hire my brother onto my team?
ground_truth: Only with written approval from HR before the arrangement begins. An undisclosed reporting relationship of that kind is a conduct issue on its own, separate from any question of favoritism.
source_anchors: Hiring or directly managing a family member or partner requires written approval from HR

question: Does Meridian ask candidates for their salary history?
ground_truth: No. Salary history is not asked at any stage, and where a candidate volunteers it the recruiter does not record it or pass it to the hiring manager.
source_anchors: Meridian does not ask for salary history at any stage

question: Are take-home exercises paid?
ground_truth: The skills exercise is time-boxed and paid where it exceeds 2 hours. Meridian does not use unpaid multi-day take-home exercises.
source_anchors: The skills exercise is time-boxed and paid where it exceeds 2 hours

question: Can a new hire read the internal documentation before their start date?
ground_truth: No. Accounts are created but disabled until the start date, because access before employment begins creates both a security and a wage-hour problem.
source_anchors: A new hire has no system access before their first day

question: Can my manager stop me applying for another job inside Meridian?
ground_truth: No. Managers may not block an internal application, and an employee is not required to tell their manager before applying, though HR encourages it.
source_anchors: Managers may not block an internal application

question: What class can I fly for a 7 hour flight?
ground_truth: Premium economy. It is permitted for flights of 6 hours or more. Business class requires VP approval and is normally approved only for flights over 10 hours where the employee works the day of arrival.
source_anchors: Premium economy is permitted for flights of 6 hours or more
notes: Boundary case just above the 6 hour threshold.
